verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents an API-driven account opening flow: create person and business applications, then an account application. It covers both business and personal accounts, initial funding, and integration of a bank-approved KYC/KYB vendor. A free Developer Sandbox is documented for testing the API before going live. missing for 10: explicit evidence that accounts are FDIC-insured, documentation that approval from application to active status is fully automated rather than bank-reviewed, explicit sandbox parity for the account-opening flow specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
